releaseNotes: Adds six technically validated country-channel entries. Sports kick-off clocks now use SAST (Africa/Johannesburg). Includes independent team/league search and current-season fixtures up to 365 days where provider data is available. IMPORTANT: directory search and future schedules require matching SPARK TV backend routes to be deployed; those features may show as unavailable until the backend update is live. Includes ARM64 and ARMv7 sideload APKs; Android requires user approval to install.
